About

Beauty and grooming, under one roof

A unisex salon in Lahore offering hair, nails, makeup and skincare services across three branches.

For everyone

As a unisex salon, A. The Salon welcomes all clients looking for professional beauty and grooming services — from everyday hair care to a complete look for a special occasion.

Three Lahore branches

Visit the main branch at 10-A CCA, DHA Phase 5, or choose Johar Town or Pine Avenue — whichever is closest to you. Every branch is open daily, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Services

What we do

Four core services — call your branch for current availability and details.

Hair

Hair services for styling and grooming, for all clients at our unisex salon.

Nails

Nail care and manicure services to complete your look.

Makeup

Makeup services for everyday elegance and special occasions.

Skincare

Skincare and facial treatments for refreshed, cared-for skin.
